{{Quote|Lieutenant Gundo, Eighty-sixth Infantry. You're here just in time.|Gundo|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
The '''Eighty-sixth Infantry''' was a [[Division/Legends|division]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3642 BBY]], a detachment assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]]'s [[Adrenal Research Base]] under [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gundo]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sajar]] were forced to defend the compound when it came under attack by [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]] during the Empire's [[Quesh war|invasion]] of the world.

==History==
{{Quote|We've got Imperial forces massing outside. My engineers jury-rigged some ray shields, but it'll take time to seal the base. Unless you people hold the main entrance, we're dead.|Lieutenant Gundo|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
[[File:Adrenal_Research_Facility_In.png|thumb|left|220px|The Eighty-sixth Infantry defend the research facility from Imperial forces.]]
A [[Division/Legends|division]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Eighty-sixth [[Infantry/Legends|Infantry]] was one of many units stationed at [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic military]] bases across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3642 BBY]], when the [[Galactic War]] broke out between the two galactic powers,<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> a detachment under the command of the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gundo]] had been assigned to guard the [[Adrenal Research Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sajar]], a former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and the apprentice of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]], was also assigned to the base so that he could [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] on the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] while still serving the Republic. Gundo's detachment included several [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] who worked with the facility's staff, and the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were forced into battle<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> when the Empire [[Quesh war|invaded]] the planet to force the Republic fully into open war.<ref name="Toxic Clash">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Toxic Clash|Quesh}}</ref>

When Gundo's men captured Imperial [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], Sajar accidentally succumbed to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] them in interrogation, and his subsequent rage-fueled taunting of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]] drew the ire of the attackers. Once he came to his senses, Sajar was horrified and refused to fight in fear of slipping further towards the dark side, leaving Gundo and his men significantly outnumbered. However, with the help of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], who had been sent by Braga to learn why his apprentice was not responding, the Eighty-sixth Infantry was able to push back the Imperial attackers and set up several jury-rigged [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]] to protect the facility until reinforcements arrived.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

==Equipment==
As an infantry division in the Republic Army, the Eighty-sixth was outfitted with standard [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. The division's armor featured white, gray, and gold [[Color/Legends|coloring]], and many soldiers carried standard-issue [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]].<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eighty-sixth Infantry first appeared in the Jedi Knight class mission "The Emperor's Wrath" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />
